info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Account Recovery API facilitates the process of retrieving customer account recovery information based on a specified parameter. This endpoint enables businesses to efficiently access critical account details necessary for assisting customers in regaining access to their accounts. Ideal for financial institutions and customer support applications, this API enhances service efficacy by providing real-time account recovery insights. Typical consumers of this API include customer service agents and automated support systems managing customer inquiries regarding account recovery.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve detailed information about a specific account recovery request using the provided account ID. It is useful for tracking the status and information related to account recovery processes.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating the account recovery process for a customer with the specified identifier. This operation expects a JSON object that contains the necessary information to verify the identity of the customer and initiate the account recovery process.

200.description: Request completed successfully with account recovery details.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Request.description: Request body for the Account Recovery operation.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Response_20.title: Account Recovery Response

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party associated with the customer.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the customer.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the customer's relationship became effective.

relationshipTier.description: Level of relationship the customer has with the organization.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record pertaining to the customer.

version.description: Version number of the response schema.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate multiple requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region in which the request was processed.

GetCustomerManagementByParam1Response_20.description: This schema represents the response for the account recovery operation.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that was accessed. This should be a string that helps in tracking the specific operation.

X-Runtime-App.description: The version of the application that handled the request. This string allows for better debugging and tracking of API interactions.
